label: IP Phone 8841
description: Cisco IP Phone 8841 five-inch colour SIP/Unified CM desk phone with an internal two-port 10/100/1000 switch for the phone and a co-located PC. Sized as 802.3af class 2, accepting 802.3at switch ports and CDP/LLDP-PoE power negotiation.
notes: Datasheet: 'An internal 2-port Cisco Ethernet switch ... 10/100/1000BASE-T ... single LAN connectivity for both the phone and a co-located PC', 'IEEE Power over Ethernet class 2', compatible with 802.3af and 802.3at blades, CDP and LLDP-PoE. Power input rating 0.917 A at 48 V DC, under 6.49 W. Separate 802.1Q VLANs can be set per PC and voice port, which is the interesting bit in a lab. No Wi-Fi or Bluetooth; the aux and headset ports are not modelled.
